proposals.evidence: Turner gives Hindi/Punjabi macchar and Gujarati machrũ mosquito/gnat under matsara². Nimadi macarī and Bhilali michiriyā fit the same affricate-plus-r stem with regional feminine endings; the i-vowel variants are qualified comparisons, not evidence for a universal vowel law.
